title: cyperus cyperoides var. evolutior
intro: Cyperus cyperoides var. evolutior, commonly known as the Umbrella Palm or Galingale, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae) and is native to tropical Asia. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus cyperoides var. evolutior include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
